note: One real round trip: simulated device (experiment 06 recording), local Ollama model. Times are epoch ms.

request.prompt:
You are a guitar practice coach. A forearm EMG sensor measured the fretting hand's tension during one practice segment. Levels: relax, medium, hard (hard = squeezing more than needed).

Segment data:
- duration: 12.1 s
- time share: relax 82%, medium 10%, hard 7%
- entries into hard: 2; longest continuous hard: 0.6 s
- tension as a multiple of the relax baseline: mean 1.265, 90th percentile 2.228, max 4.12
- current hard_scale: 1.00

Reply with JSON only: {"feedback": string, "command": {"hard_scale": number} or null}.
- feedback: one sentence for the player, at most 20 words, based only on the numbers above. No medical claims.
- command: hard_scale multiplies the threshold of the hard level (1.0 = default). Lower it (stricter) when the player was mostly relaxed, raise it (more lenient) when hard dominated the whole segment, otherwise null. Allowed range 0.80 to 1.50; change it by at most 0.10 at a time.

coach.feedback: Maintain consistent tension to avoid discomfort.
